changeSet.author: dms
changeSet.comment: Q-17: two roles - Maker enters, Checker approves

column.name: description
column.value: Creates packages, uploads documents and enters procurement data

column.name: description
column.value: Verifies captured values, completes stages and approves budget

changeSet.sql:
-- Maker: capture and view, plus the document upload rights the DMS already models INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM roles r, permissions p WHERE r.name = 'MAKER' AND p.name IN ('PROCUREMENT_VIEW','PROCUREMENT_CAPTURE','DOCUMENT_UPLOAD','DOCUMENT_VIEW');
-- Checker: everything the Maker can do, plus verification, override and budget approval INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM roles r, permissions p WHERE r.name = 'CHECKER' AND p.name IN ('PROCUREMENT_VIEW','PROCUREMENT_CAPTURE','PROCUREMENT_VERIFY', 'PROCUREMENT_OVERRIDE','BUDGET_APPROVE','DOCUMENT_UPLOAD','DOCUMENT_VIEW');

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE role_id IN (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE name IN ('MAKER','CHECKER')); DELETE FROM roles WHERE name IN ('MAKER','CHECKER');
